protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS. Real CWE-1284 DoS. Source: untrusted image bytes via ExifReader.load()/loadView() -> ImageHeader.parseAppMarkers() collecting JPEG APP2 ICC_PROFILE chunks -> IccTags.read() concatenating chunks -> parseTags(). Sink: the mluc branch in src/icc-tags.js reads attacker-controlled numRecords (tagOffset+8) and recordSize (tagOffset+12), then for-loops recordNum < numRecords, val.push(...) and offset += recordSize with no minimum stride and no table-fit check. recordSize=0 (or otherwise <12) plus a large numRecords yields a non-advancing loop and a result array sized from tag fields rather than input length. GHSA-h64w-w9pr-82m4 is not withdrawn; CVE-2026-8813 CVE.org/CNA record is PUBLISHED (Snyk CNA, state PUBLISHED, datePublished 2026-05-19) describing the same zero-size/record-count memory-growth DoS. Fix parent still contains the unbounded loop (blame on c9d88b67e127b2dcc7b46e328df468257fb2dc30^ lines 156-169 all 86bab29b9ca12caaef904e05106c9f77b3159965).
